stages.name: calibration
stages.goStop: noise STOP; >=6/8 first-attempt-valid; D7-lite |delta| <= 3.0 at BOTH the mid band and the high band (>=1 sealed 2026-07-15 owner-adjudicated reference unit ~90) else decision-rule 7's 75 gate is dropped as uncalibrated and D7 is descriptive-only

stages.name: screening
stages.goStop: advance <=2: no candidate-attributable gate-2/3 failure x2 cells; mean E >= advance floor; no block < block floor; 0 qualify -> STOP (Sol stays provisional)

stages.name: Sol@high arm
stages.goStop: DROPPED by default (budget; owner-revivable with its own budget)

stages.name: confirmation
stages.goStop: leader's Delta sign holds on >=3/4 cells; holdout not inverted

stages.name: resolver
stages.goStop: only if the pre-registered decision inputs are indeterminate (sign inconsistency across blocks, or |mean Delta| inside the W band); requires NEW owner authorization; pre-registered rule applies first

stages.name: full-book pilot
stages.goStop: outside this assignment (recommendation only); entry requires Stage-2 clear + BEFORE-PILOT items

ladder.action: Drop Stage-1 D7-lite entirely for the block selectSmallestSpreadBlock() selects — its 3 model cells + its 1 drift unit (12 -> 8 D7-lite sessions; information criterion, never outcome-direction).
Drop replicate 2 (E-audit and any surviving D7-lite) for the SAME block R1 selected — never a different block, and never applied without R1 first.
Halt the campaign for new owner re-authorization. No further degradation is applied — the ladder ends here, not at a lowered bar.

stage1AtCapWithoutConfirmationRule: Stage 1 at cap without confirmation = STOP. Never run Stage 1 to its registered cap and then enter Stage 2 on an unconfirmed outcome or without headroom for Stage 2's planned spend — halt and escalate for re-authorization (apply the degradation ladder first) instead.
